scan-observation-invalid-card.reason: Core validates card checksums; Python 4.8.1 accepts this card-shaped value. Experimental precision difference, not a claim of full parity.

scan-observation-boundary.reason: Core rejects the SSN embedded in an ASCII alphanumeric token; Python 4.8.1 detects the numeric substring.

locale-unknown.reason: The capability adapter rejects the unadvertised locale with a backend-specific diagnostic instead of the Python regex locale inventory. The exception remains ValueError.

error.message: Unsupported locale for the Rust backend: 'xx'

scan-observation-ambiguous-number.reason: Core's North American area-code check requires a leading digit of 2-9, so a bare 10-digit run starting with 1 stays undetected. This is the deliberate Unix-timestamp protection; Python 4.8.1 matches it.

locale-default-DE_TAX_ID.reason: CORE-17/PY-L2 suppress a German tax identifier from the generic PHONE detector even when German detectors are not activated. Explicit locale selection still detects DE_TAX_ID.

review: Core 1.5 candidate qualification retains reviewed historical differences and documents the contextual tax-ID correction. Wrapper 4.12 fixes are layered separately in wrapper-4.12.0.json.
